evidence: The film compositions were measured with an INCA 350 energy dispersive x-ray spectrometer (EDX) connected with a Hitachi S-4800 field emission scanning electron microscope (FESEM). For electrical characterization, Al electrodes were e-beam evaporated on the films through a shadow mask. A Keithley 2400 source meter was used for the measurements of current density voltage (J-V) characteristics while a Hewlett Packard 4284A Precision LCR meter was used to record the capacitance-voltage (C-V) characteristics. The J-V and zero-time breakdown characteristics were measured with 0.1 V /s voltage ramps. The voltage was swept from inversion to accumulation and back to inversion with 0.05 V /s. The capacitance values decreased monotonously with the increase of Ti content in the case of AlxTiyOz mixtures.
